## What changes?

Describe the benchmark, tooling, or documentation change.

## Benchmark impact

- [ ] No intended change to existing benchmark outcomes

If comparability changes, explain why and how the benchmark version should change.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q`

- [ ] flawed candidate completes as an evaluation fixture
